integrity: All finite claims are reconstructed from the IPP1/IPP2 conditions and exhaustive enumeration of all 65536 ambient subcodes; no timeout or partial search is used.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns IPP subcodes of the standard quaternary linear [4,2,3] MDS code, not arbitrary quaternary length-four IPP codes; affine profiles are counted but not claimed to be a complete automorphism-orbit classification.
title: Exact IPP deletion threshold in the quaternary \([4,2,3]\) MDS code
